reviews.comment: This professor does not seem competent at all. Not only is he a structural/civil engineer teaching a programming-based class, but he himself does not exhibit any coding knowledge, nor is he able to teach it to the class. "Lectures" include the professor simply reading the slides, and he does not effectively answer any question regarding the class.

reviews.comment: The professor wouldn't even know what was going on, and didn't know when he had work opened for students, and  didn't try to understand why the students were angry about grades. He doesn't even grade most of the work and gets someone else to do it.

Oscar Lopez is not a good professor. The coursework itself is pretty easy with a few hard programs here and there, but the tests are extremely hard and combined are both worth 35% of your grade. He rarely inputs grades, to the point where the final is nearing and nobody knows their midterm grade. He doesnt know how to answer anyones questions.
Hes a nice guy,  Im sure hes good at his job, but hes a Civil Engineer teaching how to program with Python.

Lopez is a horrible professor. The assignments themselves are not hard, but he as a teacher just reads the slides and when you ask a question he has absolutely no idea how to answer it. He also doesn't really know what's on his syllabus so don't rely on that he added, moved, and changed assignments. Try to take it with someone else.
